name: g_enemyAnim2dPackPathDesc
comment: 8-word descriptor in .rodata for 2D enemy battle animation pack archives: word +0 is zero/type tag, word +1 (offset +0x04) is a pointer to the format string '2d/battle2/enemy_anim/%s/%s.pack' (0x00789B68), word +2 is argument count 2, followed by parameter flags. Referenced across maybe_Data_BuildTaggedRecord44 (0x00160D54), maybe_Resource_AddEntryById (0x001BB9FC), and maybe_Fs_LoadMemberAndAssign (0x00467D10) when formatting archive paths for monster sprite animation packs.
evidence: Address 0x0072D74C in .rodata. Referenced by literals 0x00160DA8 (in maybe_Data_BuildTaggedRecord44 at 0x00160D54), 0x001BBBF8 (in maybe_Resource_AddEntryById at 0x001BB9FC), and 0x00467DB4 (in maybe_Fs_LoadMemberAndAssign at 0x00467D5C). In all three functions, word +4 is loaded as the format string argument passed into snprintf/format helpers 0x006F0C10 and 0x00707BD4 with monster model/anim IDs to open the '2d/battle2/enemy_anim/%s/%s.pack' resource pack. Word +0 is 0x00000000, word +1 is pointer 0x00789B68, word +2 is 2 (format argument count).

name: g_transitionDuration
comment: Global single-precision float in .data representing the time duration / scale divisor for normalized unit ratio calculations: read by maybe_Math_ClampUnitRatio (0x006283EC) and Math_GetGlobalTransformA (0x0017D2D4) to compute and clamp progress t = elapsed / duration into [0.0f, 1.0f] for camera snapshots and ride orientation transitions.
evidence: 4-byte float at 0x007A6E90 in .data (incorrectly guessed as u8 by Ghidra). Loaded via literal 0x00628444 in maybe_Math_ClampUnitRatio (0x006283EC) with 'vldr s2, [r1]' and divided into the elapsed timer float at [r0 + 0x18] ('vdiv.f32 s4, s3, s2'), followed by 'vcmpe.f32' clamping against 0.0f and 1.0f. Also referenced via literal 0x0017D2D4 in Math_GetGlobalTransformA (0x0017D044) alongside sibling motion limit floats at 0x007A6E70 and 0x007A6E84.

name: g_animCurveDispatchTable
comment: 2D function-pointer dispatch table in .data (6 curve types x 8 interpolation modes, 48 entries / 0xC0 bytes) for animation curve evaluation: indexed as type * 0x20 + mode * 4 by Anim_Curve_Dispatch (0x0065B890) to tail-call specialized curve evaluation helpers (Anim_CurveEval_F0M1 at 0x006EAA98, Anim_CurveEval_F1M1 at 0x006EB2E0, Anim_CurveSample_F2M0 at 0x006EB974, Anim_CurveSample_F3M0 at 0x006EF140).
evidence: Table at 0x007AE7C8 in .data. Loaded via literal 0x0065B8C4 in Anim_Curve_Dispatch (0x0065B890), which normalizes ratio in s0 via 0x0065B760, loads curve type from byte [r4 + 0x0C] ('add r0, r2, r0, lsl #5'), loads mode from byte [r4 + 0x0D] ('ldr r1, [r0, r1, lsl #2]'), and branches to r1 ('bx r1'). Initial word 0x006EAA98 is Anim_CurveEval_F0M1; subsequent entries point to curve evaluation routines across 0x006EAA6C..0x006EF5AC.

name: g_defaultBoundingSphere
comment: Default 4-float bounding sphere template in .bss (16 bytes / 4 floats: center x, y, z = 0.0f, radius = 0.0f): copied as fallback/initial sphere by Math_ComputeBoundingSphere (0x00573600), Math_MinimumEnclosingSphere (0x005737A4), Font_CacheGlyphsForText (0x002E7064), Gfx_Scene_CreateSpritesFromResource (0x002E7940), and Field_SceneObjectCtor_vt1D582C (0x001D564C).
evidence: 16-byte block at 0x007E71BC in .bss. Loaded across 17+ call sites via literals 0x001D5830, 0x002E727C, 0x002E7A94, 0x0057369C, 0x00573A44. In Math_ComputeBoundingSphere (0x00573600) when point count is 0, four 32-bit words are loaded ('ldm r0, {r0..r3}') and stored into the caller's output sphere buffer. In Font_CacheGlyphsForText (0x002E6E9C) and Gfx_Scene_CreateSpritesFromResource (0x002E7914), it is loaded via 'ldm' alongside g_defaultBoundingBox (0x007E7204) and g_identityMatrix4x3 (0x007E7110) to initialize composite scene node bounds. Initialized as all zeros in BSS (center 0,0,0, radius 0).
